facts.label: Marijuana Retailer licenses issued
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Filter the licence file to LICENSE_TYPE = 'Marijuana Retailer'. 955 licences of all types statewide.

facts.label: Retailers that have commenced operations
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Of the 457 retailer licences, 406 have COMMENCE_OPS = 'Yes'. 51 have not.
facts.note: The CCC publishes commencement status directly, which most states do not. Licensed and trading are different numbers and this file lets you separate them.

facts.label: Retailer licenses issued but not yet trading (11 percent)
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: 457 minus 406. Stage split across all retailer licences: 409 final, 47 provisional, 1 provisional consideration.

facts.label: Share of equity-track retailer licenses that have opened
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Retailer licences with PRIORITY_REVIEW_TYPE of 'Social Equity Participant' (47) or 'Economic Empowerment Priority' (27) total 74, of which 52 have COMMENCE_OPS = 'Yes'. 52/74 = 70 percent.
facts.note: CRITICAL PAIRING: never publish this without the general-applicant comparison below. Alone it invites a wrong reading. The point is the gap between the two, not the level of either.

facts.label: Share of general-applicant retailer licenses that have opened
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Retailer licences with PRIORITY_REVIEW_TYPE = 'General Applicant' total 218, of which 202 have COMMENCE_OPS = 'Yes'. 202/218 = 93 percent.

facts.label: Average adult-use retail price per gram, June 2026
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission, average retail price per gram series

facts.label: Average adult-use retail price per gram, November 2018
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission, average retail price per gram series
facts.verify: First row of the same series: 2018-11, 14.17, Grams. The decline to 3.87 is 72.7 percent.
facts.note: Compute the fall from these two published figures rather than quoting a percentage from anywhere else.

facts.label: Massachusetts towns with at least one open retailer
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Distinct ESTABLISHMENT_CITY among the 406 open retailers. Boston 37, Worcester 15, Northampton 10, Brockton 10, Cambridge 10.

facts.label: Towns with exactly one open retailer
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Group the 406 open retailers by town and count towns with one. 64 of 150.

facts.label: Distinct businesses holding retailer licenses
facts.source: Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission open data, licence file l_licenses_all_details_public
facts.verify: Distinct BUSINESS_NAME among retailer licences. The largest hold three each, including Cultivate Leicester, Alternative Therapies Group II, New England Treatment Access and Temescal Wellness.

gaps: Per-town open/closed status over time: the file is a snapshot, so it cannot show whether a town's count is rising or falling. Re-pull quarterly to build a trend.
Tax rate: Massachusetts levies state excise plus a local option. Not yet sourced to a Department of Revenue page. Do not publish a rate without one.
Why equity licences convert to open at a lower rate is not in this data. Report the gap, do not speculate about causes on the page.
